title: feat(cli): port the deterministic scenario scorer — shape score, artifact graph reader and Run grader — with a discrimination self-test
body:
Fixes #30290

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把云端评测里的确定性打分器搬进 `packages/cli/src/lint`(三个新文件:结构打分 `scenario-score.ts`、构建产物转打分图 `scenario-graph.ts`、对话回合判分 `scenario-run-grade.ts`),各带测试;不调用任何模型,不加命令行参数,不加包入口导出,目前没有调用方。
- 为什么改:cloud#3600 D2 裁决「打分器可以迁移到开源项目」,场景库需要一个开源、纯代码的打分器;成本裁决「目前阶段尽量不要用云端的token，api的更贵」排除了模型评审。搬运时用 5 个黄金样例做「区分度自测」,实测原代码有两处会给坏构建打满分(导航指向不存在的对象、仪表盘组件绑定不存在的数据集),已在本 PR 修掉。
- 风险与回滚:风险低。只新增文件,没有任何现有代码引用它们,发布面只多出 `dist/lint/scenario-*` 三个模块(包入口不可达);回滚即删这三个文件和它们的测试。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-score.ts`(看顶部「与云端源码的差异」一段和 `scoreGraph` 的导航检查、`measureChecks`);`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-graph.ts`(只按 spec 的唯一形状读产物,读不懂就抛错);`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-score.test.ts`(区分度自测)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/lint/scenario-score.test.ts src/lint/scenario-graph.test.ts src/lint/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`,预期 3 个文件、33 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Ported under the cloud#3600 D2 ruling from the cloud eval harness (`structural-score.ts`, the graph reader in `agent-e2e.ts`, and `ask-accuracy/scorer.ts`), each file with the Apache-2.0 header and one provenance line. No model call anywhere; no new CLI flag; no new package-entry export.

- **`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-score.ts`**: `ScenarioExpectation` (field-for-field the card's `expect` block, mirrored from the sibling contract and not imported), `EvalGraph`, `scoreGraph` (exact names), `ShapeExpectation`, `deriveShape` and `scoreGraphShape` (name-agnostic). The reference type set is the spec's `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`.
- **`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-graph.ts`**: `artifactToEvalGraph(artifact)` reads a built `dist/objectstack.json` into the graph. Collections come through `resolveStackCollection` (`@objectstack/core`, already re-exported by `utils/stack-collections.ts`), the rule the CLI and `@objectstack/verify` share, so a multi-package artifact with its collections only under `packages[]` (ADR-0130 option B) reads the same as a single-package one. ⛔ No local walk of `packages[]`. Each key is read in its one spec shape (`fields` record, `reference` via `referenceTargetOf`, `navigation` + nested `children`, widget `dataset` + `values`); the cloud reader's alias chains (`navigation ?? nav ?? tabs ?? …`, `reference_to ?? referenceTo ?? reference`) are deliberately not carried over. An object with no name or a `fields` that is not a record throws a `TypeError` instead of being read as an empty (degraded) object. A fixed-target type (`user`) gets no `reference` in the graph; which types fix their target is asked of the spec (`referenceTargetOf({ type })`), not listed here.
- **`packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-run-grade.ts`**: `gradeRun(truth, hidden, { replyText, toolCalls: [{ name, input, output }] })` returns `{ correct, cited, leaks, problems }`. The dataset and the hosted-chat transcript type are cut out: the caller passes the truth figures and the hidden scope (objects, fields, hidden values, hidden aggregates). A tool call answered over a hidden field is detected structurally (every key and string in the input), not through a list of tool parameter names, so a raw `sort` / `group_by` spelling is still seen. Records-in-order and refusal-wording grading belonged to the cloud dataset's question kinds and are not ported.

### Two deviations from the cloud source, both measured

The discrimination self-test degrades each golden build one defect at a time and requires a strictly lower score. With the cloud semantics restored, two degradations score exactly as high as the intact build:

1. `nav:TARGET->exists` asked whether an object/dashboard/app of that name exists, not whether any app navigates to it. Now it passes only when an app nav entry targets the name and resolves, and every app nav entry is scored for resolving (`nav-resolves:TARGET`), as the shape scorer already did.
2. A widget bound to a dataset the graph does not carry passed its measure check (`!ds ||`). A local artifact is the whole build, so that binding dangles and now fails, in both scorers.

Smaller: the field target key is `reference` (the spec's) rather than `reference_to`, and the platform-object prefix is `sys_` / `ai_` (no `cloud_`).

## Tests

All readings at `c0a6cf98` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), the final commit, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (shared-box seconds).

- New suites: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint/scenario-score.test.ts src/lint/scenario-graph.test.ts src/lint/scenario-run-grade.test.ts` gave `Test Files  3 passed (3)` · `Tests  33 passed (33)`.
- Package unit tier: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` gave `Test Files  387 passed (387)` · `Tests  5460 passed (5460)`. The `integration` tier is left to CI: the diff touches no integration file, spawn entry, or driver/kernel boot path.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exited 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`). `eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli/src/lint/scenario-*.ts` exited 0.

<details><summary>Discrimination self-test and the two ablations (one-time proof, not kept as tests)</summary>

Every intact golden build scores 1 on both scorers. Each variant (missing lookup, optionless select, dangling nav target, dangling dashboard measure, dangling dashboard dataset) scores strictly lower on both `scoreGraph` and `scoreGraphShape`, over 5 builds (optionless select over 4).

The cloud semantics were put back with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit, and it restores to `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`):

1. Nav check reverted to `targets.has(norm(navName))` with the per-entry `nav-resolves` loop removed. Result: 3 failed / 13 passed in `scenario-score.test.ts`. That includes `dangling nav target` with `invoice_with_line_items exact: expected 1 to be less than 1`, which means the degraded build scored the same 1.00 as the intact one. Restored: blob `eed52bc0d3ca` == HEAD.
2. Measure check reverted to `!ds ||`. Result: 1 failed / 15 passed, `dangling dashboard dataset` with `invoice_with_line_items exact: expected 1 to be less than 1`. Restored: blob `eed52bc0d3ca` == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Clause-② measurement</summary>

After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, I walked the declaration closure of the three package entries (`dist/index.d.ts`, `dist/console.d.ts`, `dist/hook-body.d.ts`). It holds 39 declaration files, and 0 of them are under `dist/lint/`. Positive control: the same walker started at `dist/lint/scenario-graph.d.ts` finds 2 files under `dist/lint/`. Reading: `Clause-②: no`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- PM mechanism assumption on the artifact reader: the CLI already has the reader, `resolveStackCollection` (re-exported by `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts`), and it is reused. `packages/verify/src/artifact-collections.ts`'s `declaredCollection` was not used: it answers a different question (a truthy top level wins, so a declared-empty array behaves differently) and the CLI does not reach into `@objectstack/verify` for a read it already owns.
- PM mechanism assumption on the corpus: the 5 fixtures in `corpus.ts` carry objects only (no app, dataset or dashboard), so the self-test completes each with an app (nav over every object and the dashboard), one dataset and one dashboard, then parses the result with `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` (the parse `os build` runs before writing the artifact). Every intact build scores 1 on both scorers; the reproduction of the "always 1.00" blind spot is the two ablations below, not the intact scores.
- `blog_post_with_comments` declares no select, so the optionless-select variant runs on 4 of 5 builds; the test pins that count.
- The two scorer blind spots also live in the cloud source this was ported from (`carrier: cloud`, reported to the seat, not filed here).

## Verification

Gate list from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths: the script takes the change set from the merge-base). Each command ran at `c0a6cf98`, with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 57 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

- 57 exited 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because its pinned positive-control commit was missing on a shallow checkout. After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` it exited 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads `dist/` of 10 packages outside this diff's build closure).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:i18n-coverage`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (the showcase config loads packages without build output, e.g. `@objectstack/service-print`).
- Both are declared narrowings, and CI runs them on its full build. The diff touches neither dual-build output nor i18n.
